target.title: docs: clarify plugin package live proof
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a documentation gap where plugin authors and maintainers could conflate source/archive installs, `npm-pack:` package proof, and trusted official plugin proof when validating plugin packages. That made it easy to miss runtime dependency mistakes or to overstate what a local tarball install proves for privileged plugin behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds package/live-proof guidance in the OpenClaw testing skill and clarifies the plugin docs. The docs now separate managed package dependency proof via `npm-pack:` from catalog-linked official trust proof, and the plugin quickstart now calls out runtime dependency ownership plus the need for built JavaScript entries before package-install validation.

## User Impact

Plugin authors and reviewers get a clearer path for validating release-candidate plugin packages. They can catch dependencies left in `devDependencies`, avoid manual repairs inside managed npm projects as final proof, and know when privileged official plugin behavior needs a second trusted install proof.

## Evidence

- `pnpm docs:list`
- `pnpm docs:check-mdx`
- `pnpm docs:check-links`
- `pnpm format:docs:check`
- `git diff --check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` clean after addressing review findings about `npm-pack:` trust scope, quickstart runtime dependencies, and peer install flags.
